exposure: fetal fraction of cell-free DNA at the first trimester
fetal fraction of cell-free DNA at the second trimester
cohort: The study included 14,020 singleton pregnancies who underwent noninvasive prenatal testing.
finding: No statistically significant association was found between the fetal fraction of cell-free DNA at the first and second trimesters and spontaneous preterm birth.
gest_age: Participants were categorized into a term group (>=37 weeks of pregnancy) and a spontaneous preterm group (<37 weeks of pregnancy).
